title: A Finite-Rate Selection Law for Annealed Gibbs Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2611.29041v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Annealed Gibbs sampling samples a multimodal model by redrawing one variable at a time from its conditional distribution as the temperature falls from a high value, where the distribution is broad, to the target temperature. Each run ends in a single mode, and unbiased Monte Carlo estimates require the runs to end in each mode in proportion to its probability under the model. At a finite cooling rate this can fail. We measure the error by $c$, the fraction of the model's log-odds between two modes that the samples retain. In the Curie--Weiss model, where a weak external field favors one of two modes, each run selects its mode near the transition at which the modes form, and rarely switches once they have separated. Near the transition, the random fluctuations of the Gibbs updates still outweigh the weak field, which therefore biases the choice of mode only slightly. translated_title: 退火吉布斯采样的有限速率选择定律
translated_abstract: 退火吉布斯采样通过在温度从高值（此时分布较宽）降至目标温度的过程中，逐次从条件分布中重抽一个变量，来对多峰模型进行采样。每次运行最终会停在一个峰（模式）中，而无偏的蒙特卡洛估计要求各次运行终止于各个峰的比例与该峰在模型下的概率成正比。在有限冷却速率下，这一要求可能无法满足。我们用 $c$ 来衡量误差，即样本所保留的模型在两个峰之间的对数几率的比例。在居里-外斯模型中（其中一个弱外场偏向两个峰之一），每次运行在峰形成的相变点附近选择其峰，且一旦峰分离便很少再切换。在相变点附近，吉布斯更新的随机涨落仍然强于弱外场的影响，因此弱场对峰选择的偏置非常轻微。基于 Kondepudi 等人提出的选择概率，我们推导了……
tldr: 本文基于Kondepudi等人的选择概率理论，在居里-外斯模型中推导出退火吉布斯采样在有限冷却速率下的模式选择定律，表明每次运行在模式形成的相变点附近即完成选择，而弱外场仅对该选择产生轻微偏置。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a finite-rate selection law for annealed Gibbs sampling in the Curie-Weiss model, showing that each run selects its mode near the transition where the modes form, with a weak external field biasing this choice only slightly.
